metadata.description: Small Claude Code mods: a context and plan-limit meter above the prompt, auto-pin for new desktop sessions, and an automatic hand-off when the context fills up

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Shows the git branch, context window usage, what the last turn added, and plan limit usage above the prompt

plugins.name: auto-pin
plugins.description: Pins a new session in the desktop app's sidebar as it starts

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: Past a context threshold, records a hand-off, resets the context (a compaction in place, or the desktop app's clear), and continues from the notes
